structure ShellNode (ε:ℝ) : Prop where
    corners : ∀ x:Cover, rad/16≤ ‖C.S.gridPoint j x‖→ ‖C.S.gridPoint j x‖≤4*rad → ∃ z:ℕ×ℕ→ C.label D,∃ A' :ℝ, F.late fun N p=> ∃ hJ: J≤N, ‖z (N,p)‖≤ A' ∧ Interior ((center C.S p hJ 0).chamber 0) (f x N p (z (N,p)))∧ (center C.S p hJ 0).rootTest (C.beta N p) (f x N p (z (N,p))) ≤ ε

proof_context.conclusion: `ShellNode` states that at each grid point of the annulus the difference has a bounded replacement whose `rootTest` in the fixed cell is at most `ε`.

have hy (i:ι):‖f i-(I i).tester S B Y‖ ≤ ε*a i:=by
       have hm:= ((I i).cost_limit j x F (d:=d) T b ho H hz (hv i) h r hE).norm
       rw [Watch.test_known]; apply le_of_tendsto hm
       apply Eventually.filter_mono hz
       let Fw (u:ℕ×ℕ):= fragment (C:=C) (d:=d) (D:=B) h r T b j x u.1 u.2 (w u)
       have hl:∀ᶠ u:ℕ×ℕ in F.fuse, ∃ hN:q≤u.1, ‖w u‖≤ Q∧ Interior ((center C.S u.2 hN 0).chamber 0) (Fw u) ∧ (center C.S u.2 hN 0).rootTest (C.beta u.1 u.2) (Fw u)≤ε:=hw
       filter_upwards [hl,hA i] with u hh hv';obtain ⟨hN,_,hW,hP⟩:=hh;obtain ⟨_,p'⟩:=hv'
       exact (p' _ hW).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (ha _))

proof_context.conclusion: `hy` turns the `ShellNode` root bound into the bound `ε * a i` for each spectator.
